description: This file declares a set of functions for drawing 2D shapes (e.g., circle, ellipse, rect, square, line, arc, point, quad, triangle, custom shapes) in a graphics context, with Lua bindings. It includes function prototypes, documentation, and example usage, primarily for rendering shapes in a Lua scripting environment.

methods.name: circle
methods.description: Draws a circle at specified position with a given diameter, exposed as a Lua binding.

methods.name: ellipse
methods.description: Draws an ellipse at specified position with given width and height, exposed as a Lua binding.

methods.name: rect
methods.description: Draws a rectangle at specified position with width and height, exposed as a Lua binding.

methods.name: square
methods.description: Draws a square at specified position with size, exposed as a Lua binding.

methods.name: line
methods.description: Draws a line between two points, exposed as a Lua binding.

methods.name: arc
methods.description: Draws an arc with specified ellipse parameters and start/stop angles, exposed as a Lua binding.

methods.name: point
methods.description: Draws a point at specified coordinates, with further styling via stroke/strokeWeight, exposed as a Lua binding.

methods.name: quad
methods.description: Draws a quadrilateral with four vertices, exposed as a Lua binding.

methods.name: triangle
methods.description: Draws a triangle with three vertices, exposed as a Lua binding.

methods.name: beginShape
methods.description: Starts custom shape definition, allowing vertices to be added.

methods.name: vertex
methods.description: Adds a vertex to the current shape.
